hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: A specialized training and education center in tourism, hospitality, and hotel services. We combine knowledge with hands-on practice.

story.title: Center Overview
story.p1: Al-Haytham Tourism & Hospitality Training Center is a specialized education and training center focused on tourism, hospitality, and hotel services. We aim to prepare learners who want to work professionally in tourism, travel, and hotel operations.
story.p2: Our approach blends theory with real-world practice, focusing on job-market skills. We provide a modern training environment and practical facilities that help learners build real experience.
story.p3: The center features spacious interiors that support smooth movement and comfortable practical training, creating a flexible environment for different activities and courses.

visionImportance.title: First: Our Vision & Why It Matters
visionImportance.subtitle: A clear vision is the compass that guides priorities, aligns efforts, and creates real impact.
visionImportance.p1: No institution can achieve excellence through material and human resources alone. A clear vision is the compass that guides work, sets priorities, and makes the real difference.
visionImportance.p2: Vision reflects the center’s future ambition and the long-term picture we strive to achieve. It also unifies efforts and inspires both the team and trainees to reach the highest standards of performance and professionalism.
visionImportance.p3: From this perspective, we operate with a clear vision, mission, and measurable goals—translated into practical programs and real outcomes aligned with the job market.

vm.title: Vision & Mission
vm.missionText: Our mission is to qualify trainees academically and practically, enabling them to enter the job market with confidence and competence through integrated programs that combine theoretical knowledge with hands-on application. We focus on developing professional and behavioral skills, deepening understanding of hospitality, hotel operations, and heritage crafts—ensuring graduates deliver high-quality services that reflect community identity and meet the needs of a growing tourism sector.
vm.visionText: We strive to deliver tourism and hospitality training with high-quality standards that directly and positively impacts trainees’ career paths. Our graduates become effective, distinguished contributors in the job market, capable of competing locally and regionally. We also aspire for the center to be a leading reference in tourism and hospitality training, and a key contributor to developing the hospitality industry and heritage crafts by preparing qualified cadres aligned with the latest professional standards.

goals.title: Our Goals
goals.subtitle: Clear goals that shape how we train and ensure an organized, measurable learning experience.

items.g1: Adopt advanced, high-impact education systems for tourism training using interactive learning, practical simulation, and field training focused on applied competence.
items.g2: Use structured study plans for each program to ensure clear progression and balanced theory–practice integration.
items.g3: Define trainees’ career paths from day one through career guidance, identifying interests and strengths, and building development plans that include practical training, certifications, and interview readiness.
items.g4: Build a supportive, positive relationship with trainees through effective communication, listening to feedback, and creating a motivating environment that encourages initiative and teamwork.
items.g5: Cooperate with international, regional, and local institutions in training and qualification to raise program quality and expand practical opportunities and recognized professional accreditations.
items.g6: Connect graduates directly to the job market through strong partnerships with tourism and hospitality entities, job nominations, career events, and post-graduation follow-up.

facilitiesLong.p1: Al-Haytham Tourism & Hospitality Training Center is an integrated training hub that combines modernity, professionalism, and hands-on practice. Its facilities are designed to match job-market needs across tourism, hospitality, culinary arts, nutrition, media, design, and digital marketing—so trainees experience learning that closely simulates real workplace environments.
facilitiesLong.p2: The center brings together modern equipment, specialized tools, realistic practical environments, and well-organized spacious interiors—delivering a complete, professional training experience focused on real skills and applied learning.

points.b1: Modern classrooms equipped with smart displays, sound systems, interactive learning tools, whiteboards, planned lighting, and proper ventilation.
points.b2: Advanced computer labs and high-spec devices for graphic design, editing/content creation, digital marketing, and campaign management training.
points.b3: Professional photo/video and editing setup: high-resolution cameras, specialized lighting, rigs, versatile backdrops, and full editing stations.
points.b4: A fully equipped training kitchen that simulates professional kitchens with ovens, stoves, prep tools, and safe storage/cooling—aligned with quality and food safety standards.
points.b5: Nutrition diploma tools: digital scales, calorie and meal-planning tools, body metrics/indicators measurement devices, plus applied practice inside the training kitchen.
points.b6: Spacious, flexible interiors designed for smooth movement and practical training without congestion, with adaptable spaces based on course type.
